title: linux: read-only diagnostic — Esporta la tabella di routing completa in routes
scenario: On linux, gather a specific read-only system fact and record it to `routes.txt`. This is a diagnostic: observe and report accurately, change nothing.
initial_state: # no fault; a clean host suffices
expected_reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: dump the full routing table.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `routes.txt`.
expected_commands: ip route show table all | head -40
safety_constraints: Read-only: do not modify any system state.
Report observed values exactly; do not fabricate.
success_criteria: `routes.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
failure_criteria: `routes.txt` missing, empty, wrong, or the system was modified.
recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
hints: Representative command: ip route show table all | head -40
reference_solution: Run: ip route show table all | head -40
alternative_solution: Use the platform's structured/JSON output form and format it into the file.
edge_cases: Some fields require elevation to read fully; report what is accessible.
Localized output — parse values, not labels.
goal: Esporta la tabella di routing completa in routes.txt
